source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of handling missing data (PDF 134-135).

blocks.text: Kuch data adhoora hota hai. Agar sirf chand qataaron mein qeematein ghayab hon to unhein hataya ja sakta hai; warna ghayab qeematein ausat ya milte julte cases ke data se bhari ja sakti hain. Intikhab data ki qism aur ghayab miqdar par munhasir hai. Agar Sara ka grade ghayab ho:

items: Imputation: maujooda data se andaza, maslan filhal use class ka ausat 82 dena, maqool farz ke saath data mukammal rakhte hue.
Flagging: note lagana ke us ka grade dastiyab nahi, ta ke analysts ko adhoore data ka pata ho; yeh shaffaf hai aur analysis jari reh sakta hai.
Removal: agar kam andraj ghayab hon to kuch analyses se us ka record nikal dena; yeh theek hai agar majmooi tasveer na bigre, magar Sara ki maloomat zaya hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Sara ke liye 82 bharna gumrah kun kyun ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ka asal grade class ausat se kahin zyada ya kam ho sakta hai, to ise andaza likh kar nishan zada karna aur asal grade milne par badalna chahiye.

items: Ghayab data: imputation (maslan class ausat), flagging, ya removal; har ek ke faide nuqsanaat.
